beats.title: Lysandra recruits the group to investigate restrictive guardhouse festivals
beats.summary: After the arena, Lysandra approaches the party in casual clothes and anxiously asks for help infiltrating a guardhouse. She explains that the festival is now guards-only and human-only, which is unusual and suspicious. In parallel, Caelynn and Karsemine arrive at the Evergreen Apothecary for a tea workshop led by Elowyn Vireleaf.

beats.title: Tea workshop success gives Caelynn new brewing skill and the party regroups
beats.summary: At the apothecary workshop, Karsemine and Caelynn brew teas for Vireleaf, with Caelynn achieving exceptional results and learning to extract bonuses from brewed teas. Bramblewood offers Karsemine special mushrooms, and the group later returns to Wolf’s Manor so Lysandra can rest while they plan the guardhouse infiltration.

beats.title: Bonogo investigates the cursed letter and learns its origin
beats.summary: Bonogo leaves the manor for the Gilded Fold paper shop to find answers about his cursed letter. He uses the blank badge of the city guard to persuade the owner Volen, who reveals the paper was made by hand for an anonymous elf and identifies the tiefling collaborator Merella; Bonogo also buys paper enchanted to resist burning.

The party then attends the Unity Dance rehearsal at Community Hall, learns the dance reenacts the battle for Mirathorn, and uses the rehearsal to blend in before heading to the guardhouse.
